Chapter 265 0262 An Anticipated New Game

What kind of game should `My Own Swordsman` be?

Chen Guiliang wasn't sure.

He only knew what had originally happened: Chi Yufeng had bought the rights to `My Own Swordsman`, and within two or three months, he had taken a half-finished product to the CJ Expo to advertise and build hype, which unexpectedly led to the showgirl Ding Beili becoming famous.

In just two or three months, even for a half-finished product, what could they possibly create?

What was even more ridiculous was that after another two or three months, `My Own Swordsman` actually went online. Apart from the names of the NPCs and places, the entire game had nothing to do with `My Own Swordsman`.

Even the appearances of the NPCs were not quite the same as in the TV series.

To put it bluntly, it was just borrowing the name to make a quick buck.

When it was first launched, fans of the TV series cursed it relentlessly. The backlash was so bad that Perfect World company took the game back for a three-year overhaul, but the result was that the core gameplay was highly similar to `Perfect World` and `Zhu Xian`.

Chen Guiliang didn't know how to make this game, which was why he had handed the task over to Feng Ji.

Now that Feng Ji had taken on this hot potato, he also had no idea what to do.

So he returned to his rented apartment and binge-watched the TV series all night long, trying to combine the essence of the show with a game.

After several days of hard thinking, Feng Ji went to find Chen Guiliang again. "Boss, the most appealing things about `My Own Swordsman` are its ordinary characters and its depiction of everyday life. If we want to make a good game based on it, we must capture these two essences."

Chen Guiliang said, "What's your plan?"

Feng Ji explained his thoughts. "First, it absolutely cannot be a free-to-play game. Otherwise, a bunch of rich players will just throw money at it, and where would the feeling of being an 'ordinary character' be? So, we should adopt the traditional time-card model."

"Second, I currently lack historical knowledge. I want to read more history books about the Ming Dynasty, visit more museums and ancient architecture, and study Ming Dynasty-related customs, clothing, music, opera, poetry, and so on. I'll try my best to restore a relatively authentic Ming Dynasty, starting from Qixia Town and expanding it into a complete ancient world."

"Just like how when you enter `World of Warcraft`, you enter the continent of Azeroth. When a player enters `My Own Swordsman`, they must feel like they've returned to the Ming Dynasty!"

If it were any other game company boss, unless they had too much money to burn, they would probably slap Feng Ji across the face upon hearing this.

I just asked you to make an online game, and you want to create a work of art for me? Free-to-play is the current trend, yet you're saying you want to make a time-card game?

Feng Ji was quite suited for Chen Tianqiao. That CEO wasn't short on money right now; instead, he was in desperate need of high-quality products with cultural depth.

In fact, one could tell Feng Ji's attitude and style of game development from `Asura`, the game for which he was the lead designer in 2008.

Chen Guiliang asked, "If you do it this way, how many years will it take to make?"

Feng Ji was a bit embarrassed. "I don't know. Maybe two years, maybe three, maybe even four."

Chen Guiliang asked again, "Then do you know that over 80% of domestically self-developed games right now have a development cycle of less than a year?"

"I know." Feng Ji felt it was definitely a lost cause. He would be lucky not to get chewed out by the boss.

But Chen Guiliang said, "Alright, then. I won't expand your team for now. You take a few people and do the preliminary preparation work. Come find me again when you feel you're ready to roll up your sleeves and get started. As for your team, you can recruit them yourself. Besides you, the limit is five people at most. I'll give you 1 million yuan in initial funding. If it's not enough, just ask for more."

"Huh?" Feng Ji thought there was something wrong with his ears.

Isn't the boss being way too indulgent?

Chen Guiliang said, "You can state your needs now. What do you require?"

Feng Ji replied, "This is enough. There's no rush to recruit the team for now. I'll first go to Peking University to audit courses on Ming Dynasty history, philosophy, and literature. I'll also seriously read the boss's `Those Things in the Ming Dynasty`. At the same time, I need to talk to Ning Caishen to familiarize myself with his complete vision for the entire story."

"These things will probably take more than half a year. Next year, I'll recruit three more members. One who is well-versed in history, culture, and customs; one who is well-versed in traditional opera and music; and one who is well-versed in Ming Dynasty ancient architecture and clothing."

"Qixia Town seems to be in Shanxi Province. I'll take the three-person team to Jincheng for an on-site investigation. We'll also design the main game map. I want to conduct on-site investigations for every city in the game."

Chen Guiliang asked, "Are you planning to make a realistic-style 3D game?"

Feng Ji shook his head. "The budget for that would be too high. If the boss is willing to spend the money, I would naturally be all for it. But there are ways to save money too. The reason I said I need to do on-site investigations and study various subjects is to capture the charm of everyday life in the Ming Dynasty. As long as we capture that charm, we can even make it in a cartoon style."

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: Damn, why am I so looking forward to this game?

Chen Guiliang said, "I'll recommend a website to you, called Tianhan Net. They are currently promoting a Hanfu revival movement. Based on my suggestions, they are also restoring various ancient customs and games. Recently, it seems they've also attracted a bunch of cold weapon and armor enthusiasts."

"There's a website like that?" Feng Ji said in pleasant surprise.

Chen Guiliang nodded. "It's full of passionate netizens. If you tell them about your game development philosophy, they will be very eager to offer you selfless help."

Feng Ji said, "Then I'll get in touch with them more."

Chen Guiliang warned, "Some netizens on Tianhan Net might have very radical ideas. Don't be influenced by them, and especially don't let those ideas manifest in the game."

"Understood."

"Alright, that's settled then."

"Boss, I'll be leaving now?"

"Wait a moment. Have the tech department create an official website for `My Own Swordsman`. First, introduce yourself, then introduce your game philosophy. Whether you're auditing classes at Peking University, talking with Ning Caishen, or conducting investigations in various places, take some photos and post them on the official website, so netizens can know your progress at all times."

"I get it. This is to build anticipation."

People who go all out and do things seriously are often trustworthy.

After hearing what Feng Ji said, Chen Guiliang himself was filled with anticipation.

Who knows what it would turn out to be in the end.

Game Science's statistics from last month were out. Monthly revenue had reached over 18 million yuan, just a tiny bit short of the 20 million target.

This was mainly due to the influx of hundreds of thousands of new players during the period of high public attention.

Moreover, they were all users with their own computers, fundamentally different from internet cafe players.

Among them were many financially stable middle-aged people who, through the newspaper flame wars, learned that a certain game had been on `Xinwen Lianbo`. Out of curiosity, they went online to search for information.

Seeing the game introduction on the Legends of the Three Kingdoms official website, along with all the skins and cosplay photos, they felt an itch they couldn't scratch and downloaded the game.

Some were also led astray by Baidu during their search, inexplicably clicking into other websites because Chen Guiliang hadn't paid Baidu for a sponsored ranking.

When searching for "Legends of the Three Kingdoms," the official website was ranked fifth. The ones before it were all advertisements for other companies!

Baidu back then still had a little bit of a conscience, at least it didn't push the official website to the second page.

If this were more than ten years later, the search results from Baidu would be nothing but ads as far as the eye could see.

Subscribing to the membership also came with props like General Selection Cards, General Swap Cards, and Hand Swap Cards. The number of generals to choose from in each game also increased, and there were bonuses for experience and mission rewards.

Of course, members could only use these for free; the Wind and Fire expansion pack generals would not be unlocked. This would be irksome for players with a collector's mentality.
